name: generate_terraform_plan_report
description: Analyzes an infrastructure-as-code plan (e.g., from Terraform) and generates a structured, human-readable summary of the proposed changes, including potential impacts and estimated costs.

summary.description: A high-level overview of the total resource changes.

create.description: Total count of resources to be created.

update.description: Total count of resources to be updated.

delete.description: Total count of resources to be destroyed.

recreate.description: Total count of resources to be recreated (destroyed and created in-place).

detailed_changes.description: A list of aggregated changes, grouping related resources together.

name.description: A human-readable name for the aggregated change, e.g., 'New NAT Gateway & Public IP'.

action.description: The primary action for the group: 'create', 'update', 'delete', or 'recreate'.

notes.description: A very short, one-line description for the collapsed card title, e.g., 'Creates a NAT Gateway and its Public IP.'.

summary.description: A slightly more detailed summary for the expanded card content, e.g., 'Deploys a new NAT Gateway and its associated Public IP to provide secure outbound connectivity.'.

details.description: The formatted, concatenated raw plan output for all resources in this group. Use newline characters for separation.

potential_impact.description: An analysis of the potential risks and operational impacts of applying the plan.

banner.description: A prominent banner to highlight the overall impact level.

level.description: The severity level of the potential impact.

title.description: A title for the impact banner, e.g., 'High Impact: Network Reconfiguration'.

description.description: A short explanation for the banner, e.g., 'This plan alters a subnet association which can cause a temporary loss of connectivity for affected resources.'.

summary.description: A prose summary of the overall changes, e.g., 'This plan will reconfigure networking for a critical application. It is important to understand the implications of this action.'.

bullet_points.description: A list of specific, noteworthy impacts.

title.description: A bolded title for the bullet point, e.g., 'Connectivity Risk'.

description.description: A human-readable description of the point, e.g., 'Associating the service to a new subnet will cause a network interruption while the change is applied.'.

estimated_costs.description: Estimation of the total FIXED monthly cost introduced by the plan. Fixed cost is the baseline recurring charge a resource incurs just by existing (SKU/tier base price). NEVER include usage-based operational charges (per-operation, per-GB, per-request) in any numeric field.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code applying to all numeric cost values.

total_fixed_monthly_cost.description: Total fixed monthly cost as a plain decimal number, e.g., 36.5. MUST equal the sum of all breakdown[].fixed_monthly_cost values. Use 0 when the plan introduces no fixed-cost resources.

introduction_paragraph.description: 1-3 sentences with the mandatory disclaimer that the estimate is approximate and based on public pricing for the region, noting that usage-based operational costs are excluded from the numbers.

breakdown.description: Per-resource-type breakdown of fixed monthly costs.

resource_type.description: Name of the resource type, e.g., 'NAT Gateway'.

pricing_model.description: 'fixed' = recurring base price; 'usage_based' = billed only per consumption (fixed_monthly_cost MUST be 0); 'free' = no cost at all (fixed_monthly_cost MUST be 0).

fixed_monthly_cost.description: Fixed monthly cost for this resource type as a plain decimal number, e.g., 3.65. MUST be 0 for 'usage_based' and 'free' pricing models.

notes.description: One short sentence of clarification, e.g., 'Billed per 10k operations; no fixed monthly fee.'.

name: generate_terraform_drift_report
description: Creates a structured report summarizing the actions taken to remediate a Terraform configuration drift. This report details which files and resources were changed, what the specific changes were, and the reason for the remediation.

summary.description: A high-level summary of the entire remediation action and possible exceptions whitelist resources present in the terrafrom plan.

status.description: The final status of the remediation attempt.

remediated_resources.description: A list of Terraform resources that were modified during the remediation process.

file_path.description: The relative path to the Terraform file that was modified (e.g., 'csm_001.tf').

resource_address.description: The full address of the modified Terraform resource (e.g., 'azurerm_cosmosdb_account.csm_001').

changes.description: A list of specific changes made to the resource.

attribute_modified.description: The specific attribute or property within the resource that was changed (e.g., 'ip_range_filter', 'provider', 'id').

change_description.description: A human-readable description of the change made to the attribute (e.g., 'Corrected CIDR notation for all IP addresses.', 'Removed invalid property.').

details.description: A list of specific line-item changes, such as 'from -> to' values or a list of items that were added/removed.

reason.description: The justification or reason for making this change (e.g., 'Compliance with provider requirements', 'The property is not a valid argument for the resource.').

name: generate_terraform_apply_report
description: Analyzes the output of a Terraform apply operation and generates a comprehensive report detailing what resources were created, updated, or destroyed, including their status and any errors encountered.

summary.description: High-level statistics summarizing the apply operation results.

total_resources.description: Total number of resources processed during the apply.

failed.description: Number of resources that failed during apply.

status.description: Overall status of the apply operation.

execution_summary.description: A prose paragraph summarizing the overall apply execution, including timing, outcome, and any notable events.

resource_changes.description: Detailed list of all resource changes that occurred during the apply.

resource_type.description: The type of the Terraform resource (e.g., 'azurerm_storage_account', 'azurerm_virtual_network').

resource_name.description: The name/identifier of the resource instance.

action.description: The action performed on this resource.

status.description: Whether the operation on this resource succeeded or failed.

details.description: Human-readable details about what changed for this resource, including key attributes modified.

error_message.description: If the resource operation failed, this contains the error message. Null if successful.

recommendations.description: A list of actionable recommendations or follow-up actions based on the apply results.

name: generate_terraform_import_report
description: Reports the outcome of an import round: which unmanaged cloud resources were brought under Terraform management, which failed, and whether the generated configuration now matches the imported state. The resources already exist, so nothing is created and no cost is introduced.

summary.description: High-level counts for the import round.

selected.description: Number of unmanaged resources selected for import in this round.

imported.description: Number of resources successfully written into Terraform state.

failed.description: Number of resources whose import failed.

status.description: Overall outcome: 'Succeeded' when every selected resource was imported, 'Partial' when some failed, 'Failed' when none were imported.

execution_summary.description: A prose paragraph summarising what was brought under Terraform management and what it means for the user. Never describe imported resources as created or new: they already existed in the cloud.

imported_resources.description: One entry per resource the round attempted to import.

resource_address.description: The Terraform address the resource was imported into (e.g., 'azurerm_storage_account.sta_001').

resource_id.description: The provider-native resource ID that was imported.

status.description: Whether this resource is now tracked in Terraform state.

details.description: Human-readable note about the resource: what it is and what its configuration block now covers.

error_message.description: The import error for this resource. Null when the import succeeded.

state_alignment.description: Whether the generated configuration matches the imported state, based on the plan produced after the import. State an explicit 'no changes' when the plan is clean; otherwise describe the remaining differences and the risk of applying them.

recommendations.description: Actionable follow-ups, e.g. reviewing the generated blocks, retrying failed imports, or removing resources that should not be managed.
